peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 32.8% above its local comparables; 135 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (29.8): 2.1 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 116 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 9). Context, not scored: resales in 45.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $1,800,000 ($2,883 psf, 624–635 sq ft; 5 resales, May 2024–Apr 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,103 psf (range $1,840–2,612); 37.1% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $487,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $4,065,000 ($3,276 psf, 1,227–1,248 sq ft; 6 resales, Apr 2024–Mar 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,549 psf (range $1,587–2,781); 28.5% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $902,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Orchard MRT about 120 m, Somerset MRT about 820 m; closer than 525 of 551 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest Anglo-Chinese School (Junior) about 960 m; more than 107 of 551 similar developments (the same as 202). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 9 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 0 m), more than 419 of 551 similar developments (the same as 42); nearest hawker centre Newton Food Centre about 990 m; nearest park Istana Park about 1,300 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 800 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 860 m; 21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 940 m; Upperhouse at Orchard Boulevard, 47 new sales, about 1,090 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 1,230 m; The Avenir, 1 new sales, about 1,350 m; Hill House, 5 new sales, about 1,380 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 1,420 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 470 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,363 new sales and 1,373 resales (2,736 purchases); new sales were 49.8% of these purchases. Subsales (32) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 720 m; Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 930 m; upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,470 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,373 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 539 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,373 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,506 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−8.8%). Planning-area private resales −58.2%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
